history.overview: The Trial of Hate tests combatants’ ability to withstand or channel overwhelming aggression amplified by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Hate Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite engineers created a trial focused on emotional volatility and aggression.

timeline.name: Rage Chambers Added
timeline.description: Chambers were built to provoke combatants into uncontrolled fury.

timeline.name: Dragorn Hate Trials
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were forced into emotionally charged confrontations.

timeline.name: Discord Hate Amplification
timeline.description: Discord pylons were installed to intensify hatred and emotional instability.
